title: Place a structural column between two levels
task: Place a vertical structural column at a point using Autodesk.Revit.Creation.Document.NewFamilyInstance with a structural column FamilySymbol, a base level and StructuralType.Column, then set its top level. Covers structural column modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: A task-phrased search like 'place a vertical structural column at a point on a level' does not surface the creation member; the top hit is the FamilyInstance.StructuralType property.
pitfalls.cause: The creation member is Autodesk.Revit.Creation.ItemFactoryBase.NewFamilyInstance(XYZ, FamilySymbol, Level, StructuralType), reached as doc.Create.NewFamilyInstance; its generic name/summary ranks poorly for structural intent (connector issue #341).
pitfalls.fix: Search with the member name, e.g. 'NewFamilyInstance place a family instance at a point with a level and structural type' (returns it at rank 1), then use the XYZ/FamilySymbol/Level/StructuralType overload with StructuralType.Column.

pitfalls.symptom: The column is created but has zero height, or warns about coincident base and top.
pitfalls.cause: Only a base level was given; the top constraint defaults to the base level.
pitfalls.fix: Set BuiltInParameter.FAMILY_TOP_LEVEL_PARAM to a higher level's Id after creation, guarding that the top level differs from the base.

hit.text: NewFamilyInstance place a family instance at a point with a level and structural type

miss.text: place a vertical structural column family instance at a point on a level
